NEIGHBORHOOD

REFLECTION

Each claim must cite exactly one representative C-number in `card_ids` and set `evidence_role` to `supportive` or `contradictory`. Do not return `supportive_card_ids`, `contradictory_card_ids`, or `prediction_basis_card_ids`; the engine derives them from the claims.
